scene1Childhood.memory: I learned to fix bicycles with my dad in our Ohio garage. We laughed when the bell fell off.

scene2TeenFreedom.memory: My first ride alone ended with a flat tire. Dad came to help, without lecturing.

scene3LeapOfFaith.memory: Years later I opened a tiny bike shop. I was scared, but Dad helped paint the sign.

scene4Romance.memory: Your mom brought coffee on opening day. We ate sandwiches on the floor.

scene5LegacyFinale.memory: Mia, now I hold your bicycle steady. Falling is okay. We can always try again together.
